title: spec-strata: Behavioral Control Through System Prompts — A Comparative Structural Analysis of Public Governance Artifacts Across Commercial LLM Deployments
description: A three-part taxonomy of behavioral-control artifacts governing LLM behavior — training-time constitutions, runtime authority specifications, and deployed system prompts — with a credibility-tiered comparative analysis across Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, and xAI.
